change: Existing trained YOLO plus frozen pretrained neural object proposals and crop verification; no new custom training in this revision. Water image model and video confirmation policy unchanged.

verification.catalogue_transport: All six MP4s: complete decode, matching dimensions/FPS/duration, H.264, faststart, HTTP Range 206 and persisted events verified.
verification.real_browser_observation: Two original user photos uploaded; annotated results and alerts visible. Known Hanoi video processed through shared API and played to its 12-second end without a media error.

limitations: Image presence improves on measured cohorts, but localization does not improve uniformly: animal box F1 declines on both known regression cohorts, including duplicate or imprecise boxes.
The difficult rato_rua clip has only one ambiguous animal proposal in 240 frames; this is not a confirmed detection success.
The known Hanoi clip has animal proposals in 144/240 frames versus 187/240 in the prior recorded profile; temporal improvement is not established.
Trash false positives remain, including functional containers and ambiguous vegetation or natural debris. Group envelopes and individual boxes can overlap; marks are not physical object counts.
The catalogue ralo_lixo photo still misses other visible trash and shallow water. Water rectangles can include surrounding concrete and do not represent exact water contours.
The extra inference stages increase latency. Catalogue clips of 10.4 to 12 seconds required approximately 67 to 91 seconds on this machine; CPU speed is not established.
Calibration, new same-domain holdout, known regressions, user examples and functional catalogue checks have separate roles and must not be combined into a single accuracy percentage.
The existing demonstration recording shows version 0.4.0 and is historical evidence only.
scope: Local deployment and verification only; no repository, model, user image or video publication performed by this activation.
